newsitem.title: TOGO: Meningitis epidemic kills 128 in Togo.
newsitem.headline: Meningitis epidemic kills 128 in Togo.

text.p: An epidemic of mengitis has killed at least 128 people in the West African state of Togo in the last two weeks, health officials said on Tuesday.

Chief epidemiologist Doctor Kodjo Aleki told reporters 127 people died from 875 cases recorded in northern Savane region alone since January 11. One death was reported from four cases in neighbouring Kara region.
Meninigitis, an inflammation of the brain and spinal cord, torments arid regions of West Africa during the dry season.
An epidemic which swept Sahelian West Africa for months from February last year killed hundreds of people in northern Nigeria, Niger, Burkina Faso and Mali.
